summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K to announce a board meeting scheduled for May 28, 2026, to consider and approve unaudited Q1 2026 financial results and host an earnings call. This is a routine earnings-related current report, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or corporate action is described. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer update comparable to an 8-K earnings release.
